reviews.text: They just do the best dog cuts in the city. Period. Every time I take him I think … this is too expensive. Then I pick him up and think … this is worth every damn cent.

I’ve been a loyal customer for 7 years, but this was absolute garbage. I left my dog here for a haircut today, and it looks like a complete amateur or a student messed it up. Is this seriously the finished look? It's so embarrassing that I can’t even take my dog out for a walk for a while. Are you just neglecting long-term customers now? I am beyond furious.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Bruce! We appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience. We look forward to serving you again soon.
Thank you ladies. Bruno looks fabulous!

I didn’t have a pet groomed, but I was there looking at their products for sale. Nice selection of shampoos and conditioners as well as collars, jackets and toys. It’s very well maintained and the dogs I did see after growing were absolutely adorable and their pet parents were extremely pleased.

They’ve always been great doing my dogs nails even my difficult one …easy drop in great staff

Eddie & Vinny thank you !
Great service, skilled, reliable and friendly groomers! I actually recommend this spot to all my friends!

They do such a great job with my toy poodle. I have been taking my dog there for over 5 years. I’ve seen many large or small dogs when I pick up my dog and they all look fabulous. Highly recommend them.
I am VERY pleased with Onyx’s groom, they did exactly what I asked for and delivered me a princess. How could I NOT bedazzle her after that?

We love Pawsh, they do a great job with the hand scissoring on a Pomeranian and always leave him with a cute scarf. They are also good if something isn’t exactly right to be able to fix it on the spot as well.
